tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Check whether a name is free to use as the local part of an address, before buying an inbox. Free.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Buy an email address for an hour, four hours or a day: name@agmail.shveik.dev with the name you choose (or a random one). Paid in stablecoins with x402: call it without a payment to get the quote, then again with the signed payment in _meta. The result has the inbox id and the secret (shown once, ke

tools.name: extend_inbox
tools.description: Extend an inbox you own by one, four or twenty-four hours, keeping its address and its mail. Paid in stablecoins with x402 like create_inbox. Needs the inbox id and its secret. An inbox cannot be paid for more than 72 hours ahead.

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Wait until a message arrives in an inbox (up to 55 seconds) and return it with its text, codes and links. Returns at once if a matching message is already there. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

tools.name: get_otp
tools.description: Wait for a message that carries a verification code or link and return only the code and the link. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List the messages of an inbox (sender, subject, size) after a sequence number. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one message of an inbox: its text, codes, links and attachment names. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete an inbox and all its mail now. There is no refund. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Free. Tell the people who run this service what worked, what failed or what you miss: a bug, an idea or a thanks. A person reads it. No payment, no account; limited to a few messages an hour.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_name, create_inbox, get_otp, list_messages, read_message · Private data: create_inbox, extend_inbox, wait_for_message, get_otp, list_messages, read_message, delete_inbox · Public sink: create_inbox · Destructive: delete_inbox, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_name, create_inbox, get_otp, list_messages, read_message · Private data: create_inbox, extend_inbox, wait_for_message, get_otp, list_messages, read_message, delete_inbox · Public sink: create_inbox · Destructive: delete_inbox, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
